en: {fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes. It's been a long time. I'm glad to see you looking well.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you seen any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Well... yes, I suppose. Do you like looking at beautiful scenery, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Asking that out of nowhere... You're a little unusual, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did my sudden visit startle you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Heh. Well... I was a little surprised.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I didn't expect an angel to say something a child would say.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}As you can see, I'm the same as ever. Have you been well, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If I can do anything, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}Thank you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But there's nothing I need to ask of you right now, so perhaps another time.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might be lost.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No need to worry. This is the right direction for where I'm going.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How do you feel about becoming a hero?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Becoming a hero hasn't changed who I am.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Saving the righteous and removing what is evil. A hero's work is a doctor's work.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Being a doctor must be hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}However hard it is, the joy of saving a life is so great that it never feels painful...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But the pain when I can't save someone is beyond words...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}That will be all, surely?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I hope you have sweet dreams.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Yes... which is why, if you don't mind...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0480}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Was I that much of a nuisance?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}...I'm sorry, but yes. It's natural to be sleepy at night, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0480}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was a little worried.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}...Did I do something to make you uneasy?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...In any case, I'm fine. There's no need for your concern.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0480}{n}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you like staying up late?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}Well, once in a while it might be nice. But tonight I'll pass.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0480}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Let's do our best tomorrow too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...Yes. But for that, sleep is extremely important.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...You do understand what I'm trying to say?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0480}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I had something urgent to ask of you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...I see. And here I was being so short with you, not knowing...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please don't look at me like that.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0480}{n}I'm fighting off sleep to listen to you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If it's such trivial talk, couldn't it wait until tomorrow?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0480}{n}{end}

{fb:3380}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I had something urgent to ask of you.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}...I see. And here I was being so short with you, not knowing...{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Meals are fun, aren't they?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well, nourishment is a necessity.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not at all. It's I who should apologize for saying I was off to eat,{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}so please don't worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are there foods you don't like?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Well... there are things I don't eat.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}As a doctor, I suppose I shouldn't say such things.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever cook your own meals?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Simple things. Elaborate dishes give you the same nourishment anyway.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Is that so? Then why not go back and have a meal yourself, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you eat at set times?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I do. I once read in a book that the human body has a rhythm.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It seems eating at regular times is important.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Why not try to do the same, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you pay attention to nutrition?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Of course! A meal without nourishment is pointless.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}So for my part, even if something is delicious, I'm not much interested if it has little nutritional value.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not at all. It was rude of me to say I was off to eat.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Please don't worry about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2980}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm getting hungry too.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is that so?{n}{e5:0080}{n}Then why not go back and have a meal yourself, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is something troubling you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No, nothing. I'm fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not at all. If you have the time, why not relax here with me?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No... I do mean to take it easy, but it isn't that I'm tired.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's just a change of pace.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look like you're having fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}I haven't had a day to relax in quite a while. An occasional day off is a pleasure.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did someone teach you that?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}My experience as a doctor.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If you ask me, people could stand to live a little more easygoing lives.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Spending time at a relaxed pace is something the body needs.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you take time off often?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}With my work as a doctor, I can't say often.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But if I overdo it and collapse, my patients will suffer, so I do allow myself some rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there something you'd like to do?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not today, but I'm thinking of going to gather medicinal herbs soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}A book I read the other day had a remedy I didn't know, and I'd like to try making it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Not at all. If you have the time, why not relax here with me?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}No... I do mean to take it easy, but it isn't that I'm tired.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's just a change of pace.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there something you'd like to do?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{e5:0080}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Not today, but I'm thinking of going to gather medicinal herbs soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}A book I read the other day had a remedy I didn't know, and I'd like to try making it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're very dedicated, aren't you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes. There's still so much a doctor must learn.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}To save even one more patient, I must gain the knowledge.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're working hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}So that's how it looks to you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}For me it's just the usual. I don't feel I'm "working hard" in particular.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep studying today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Yes. There's one more book I'd like to read.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What are you studying?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}What I'm reading now is about medicinal herbs.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Depending on how they're used, herbs can be poison or medicine, so precise knowledge is essential.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Why not rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}No. There's no need for concern. It isn't such a strain.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Has anyone ever taught you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I studied at the school of medicine in Esparda. Since then I've learned about herbs from many books.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That looks like a difficult book.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}It certainly isn't easy. But I think with time it can be understood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Still, I'm glad you take an interest in my research.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That looks like a difficult book.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0680}{n}It certainly isn't easy. But I think with time it can be understood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Still, I'm glad you take an interest in my research.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}That's all?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I bothering you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Not at all! I was just hoping I'd see you, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you tired?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}I'm fine. This is nothing!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like traveling?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Traveling's fun. When you keep on traveling, you learn all kinds of stuff!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you getting proper rest?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah! I'm resting. The other day I found a spring. Bathing in it felt sooo good!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Perfect! ...Well, not quite, but not bad.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was worried, so I came to see you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}There's nothing to worry about.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's nice to walk outside, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah. It feels super nice. You think so too, Angel? That makes me kinda happy!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Weren't you hoping to see me?{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}Huh, me? Hoping to see you? I'm not that much of a kid.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}You came all this way 'cause you were worried about that? You're so nice, Angel. But I'm okay. I'm fine for now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}It's been a while, hasn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Huh, has it?{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you seen any beautiful scenery?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Huh, scenery? I don't really look at it much, so I dunno.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did my sudden visit startle you?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0180}{n}Yeah. You surprised me. Being an angel must be great. You can go anywhere in a flash!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I was wondering how you were doing.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Did something happen, Angel? I'm the same as always.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}If I can do anything, I'll help.{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}Thanks, Angel. But I'm okay right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought you might be lost.{n}{wait}{clear}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0280}{n}I'm fine, Angel. I'm not a little kid anymore.{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Has anything good happened?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}{e5:0080}{n}The other day I found a big cave. It went way, way back. It was amazing!{n}{wait}{clear}{e5:0080}{n}{end}
